new.s: Under which of the following Acts did the East India Company remain in place under a system of dual control?
new.x: Pitt's India Act, 1784 left the Company in place under dual control. Company rule ended only with the Government of India Act, 1858.
new.angle: U0187 #1 GoI Act 1858 vs earlier Acts (transfer of power)

new.s: Lord Canning was the first to hold which of the following titles?
new.x: The Act of 1858 gave the Governor-General the added title of Viceroy, and Canning was the first Viceroy. The first Governor-General of India was Bentinck.
new.angle: U0187 #8 first Viceroy

new.s: Which event took place at the Allahabad Durbar of 1 November 1858?
o: Queen Victoria was proclaimed Empress of India
The Queen's Proclamation was read out
The Government of India Act, 1858 was passed
Bahadur Shah II was sent into exile
new.x: Lord Canning read out the Queen's Proclamation at Allahabad on 1 November 1858. Victoria became Empress of India at Delhi in 1877.
new.angle: U0187 #2/#9 Proclamation venue, date and reader

new.s: Which Viceroy is associated with the Delhi Durbar of 1877, at which Queen Victoria was proclaimed Empress of India?
new.x: The Empress of India title was proclaimed at Delhi in 1877 under Lytton; Canning read the 1858 Proclamation at Allahabad.
new.angle: U0187 #2/#9 Proclamation reader (Canning vs Lytton trap)

new.s: Which commission reorganised the Indian army in 1859 after the Revolt of 1857?
